#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, b;
    cin >> n >> b;

    vector<int> arr(n + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        cin >> arr[i];
    }

    int diff = 0;
    vector<int> balance(n + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        if ((arr[i] & 1) == 1) {
            diff++;
        } else {
            diff--;
        }
        balance[i] = diff;
    }

    vector<int> costs;
    for (int i = 2; i < n; i += 2) {
        if (balance[i] == 0) {
            costs.push_back(abs(arr[i] - arr[i + 1]));
        } else {
            costs.push_back(-1);
        }
    }

    sort(costs.begin(), costs.end());

    int cut = 0;
    long long sum = 0;
    for (int cost : costs) {
        if (cost != -1 && sum + cost <= b) {
            cut++;
            sum += cost;
        }
    }

    cout << cut << '\n';

    return 0;
}
